scientific_integrity: The original Renshaw definition and pointwise formulas and classical general Schemmel mean values are credited as prior work. Infinite claims rest on written proof; finite scripts are only consistency checks.
scientific_limitations: Weak convergence, all positive real moments, atomlessness and full support are proved. No rate, density function, negative moments, cryptographic security conclusion or independent validation is asserted; possible older equivalent literature is a priority risk.
title: An atomless limiting law for the normalized Renshaw totient
